1. నిన్నా, నేడు, రేపూ నీవు ఏకరీతిగానే ఉన్నావు.

నీ దేవుడే నా దైవం అని అన్న రూతులు
పేరు పెట్టి పిలిచి రమ్మని రక్షణ ఇంటికి తెచ్చావు.

english: Vina vinagaa bodhapade mrokkeda ee poota
Ninnaa, nedu, repu neevu ekareethigaane unnaavu
Nee devude naa daivam ani anna Ruthulu
Peru petti pilichi rammani rakshana intiki techchaavu
Shataadhipatiki unna ne maata chaalu ane vishvaasam
translation: Every knee bows and praises You.
Even the hardest stone can be broken.
Have mercy, forgive, and protect me.
Did You say, “I am here”?
Will You reveal Yourself as “I alone”?
Make me alive by dwelling within me.
You are the tireless breath within me,
As I listen, I understand—so I bow and pray now.
Verse 1
You are the same yesterday, today, and forever.
I have lived like one who wandered—
Forgive me, pardon me; these are my prayers.
“Your people shall be my people,
Your God shall be my God” (like Ruth said).
I have no one, no one at all—
Please do not reject me.
I plead and cry out to You.
Verse 2
I have seen enough—
You saw Zacchaeus.
In the crowd, no one expected it,
But You called him by name and brought salvation to his house.
Like the centurion who believed
That just one word from You is enough—
You gave life even to his servant/son.
Defeat will not come near me,
My victory is in You alone.
O King, You are my refuge.
intro: Nenu Ani Palikaavaa is the latest Telugu Christian song written by Ashakiran Pallikonda and music composed by Anand Piano Lover. This song was released on March 19, 2026, through ashakiran pallikonda YouTube Channel.

title: Oke Okka Korika – Kenny Chaitanya Telugu Christian Lyrics
telugu: శ్రమలనే కొలిమి నుండి నన్ను పైకి లాగవా
నీ కొరకై సిద్ధము చేసిన బలము కోసమే
english: Shramalane kolimi nundi nannu paiki laagavaa
Nee korakai siddhamu chesina balamu kosame
translation: Oke Okka Korika – English Translation
This song is a heartfelt plea for God’s mercy, expressing the exhaustion of a soul waiting for a breakthrough amidst long-standing trials.
Chorus
Forgive me and grant this just one request, O Jesus;
I have grown weary of asking time and time again.
I have come into Your presence; please do not cast me away;
I have been waiting for You for so many years.
Won’t You show me kindness at least this time?
Won’t You show me Your mercy at least this time?
Verse 1
I have been crushed at the hands of my adversaries;
I have been scorched in the furnace of afflictions.
I am not made of silver to endure this heat;
I am but a man of clay to bear such trials.
It is enough now, Lord;
Please pull me up from this furnace of suffering.
Verse 2
As I sow my seeds while shedding tears,
I hope to reap the harvest with songs of joy.
For the strength and fruit You have prepared for me,
I shall wait and seek You in fasting and prayer.
It is enough now, Lord;
Please pull me up from this valley of tears.
intro: Oke Okka Korika is the latest Telugu Christian song, written & tuned by Shadrak, sung by Palivela Anand and music composed by Kenny Chaitanya, produced by Krupasana ministries. This song was released on March 26, 2026, through Krupasana Ministries YouTube Channel.

పగలు రాత్రచ్చట లేదు – ప్రభువే దీపమై యుండును
5. ప్రియుని పిలుపును విని – నేను కూడా సిద్ధపడెదను
english: Naa priya Yesuni – nen eppudu gaanthuno
1. Aakali dhappulu dhuhkhamu – manovedhana ledhu achchata
Parama makutamu pondanu – Prabhu paadamula cheredanu
2. Siluva veyabadithini – ika ne kaadhu jeevinchuta
Prabhu Yesu mahima koraku – guri galigi jeevinthunu
3. Naa parugu thudhamuttimpa – naaku krupanu menduga nosagunu

translation: Heaven is my inheritance—
When will I reach there?
When will I see
My beloved Jesus?
1. There will be no hunger, thirst, sorrow,
Or mental pain there.
I will receive the heavenly crown
And reach the feet of the Lord.
2. I have been crucified (with Christ),
Now it is no longer I who live.
For the glory of Lord Jesus,
I will live with a clear purpose.
3. To finish my race,
He will give me abundant grace.
On the path of faith,
I will run without growing weary.
4. I will receive eternal rest
And enter heaven.
There is no day or night there—
The Lord Himself is the light.
5. Hearing the call of my beloved,
I will also be ready.
As the days draw near,
My longing increases more and more.
intro: Paralokame Naa Swasthyamu is the latest Telugu Christian song written by Kurian G S and music composed & sung by Hadlee Xavier. This song was released on March 25, 2026, through Hadlee Xavier YouTube Channel.

title: Siluva – Vinod Kumar Telugu Christian Lyrics
telugu: నీవు మోసిన ఆ సిలువ నాదే యేసయ్య
నీవు పొందిన కొరడ దెబ్బలు నావే యేసయ్య
నీ తలపై ముళ్ళ కిరీటం నాదే యేసయ్య
english: Aaraadhana neeke naa aaraadhana neeke Yesayyaa neeke
Neevu pondhina koradaa debbalu naave Yesayya
Nee thalapai mulla kireetam naadhe Yesayya
translation: Chorus
There is no one like You; there is no one like You.
There is no one who loves me like You do, Lord Jesus.
There is no one like You, Jesus, who would give His life for me.
There is no one like You, Jesus.
Adoration to You; my worship is for You alone, O Jesus.
Verse
The cross You carried was actually mine, O Jesus;
The stripes from the whip You received were meant for me.
The crown of thorns upon Your head was mine, O Jesus;
The nails in Your hands were meant for me.
By turning away the punishment from me and standing in my place,
You became the sacrifice on my behalf, O Jesus.

credits.Vocals: Pastor Vinod Kumar & Pastor Benjamin Johnson
credits.Music: Christ Alone Music & Eric Gerald & Jotham & Arjun & Deepak Cherian & Qompose studios

This song was released on March 25, 2026, through Pastor Vinod Kumar YouTube Channel.

title: Yesu Swamy Vanti – D Isaac Gnana Raj Telugu Christian Lyrics
telugu: దండి యేసు చావు చూసి బండలన్నీ బ్రద్దలాయెను
english: Itthi devuni orvaleka dushtajanulu Yesu prabhuvuni
Dhandi Yesu chaavu chusi bandalanni braddhalaayenu
translation: Pallavi
There is no God like Lord Jesus—none can be found.
No one else has risen like Him, O people.
People have perished and passed away, O people.
Verse 1
Born of a virgin,
He carried the cross to Calvary.
He came down from heaven,
And showed the true and righteous way.
Verse 2
Unable to accept such a holy God,
Wicked people rejected Lord Jesus.
They made Him carry the cross to Calvary,
Spat on Him and mocked Him.
Verse 3
When Jesus died,
The rocks were split apart.
The whole earth trembled,
And darkness covered the land.
Verse 4
From the tomb, on the third day,
Jesus rose again with life.
He conquered the grave, O people.
intro: Yesu Swamy Vanti is the latest Telugu Christian song and music composed by D.Isaac Gnana Raj. This song was released on March 24, 2026, through Satyadaivarchana Tv YouTube Channel.

title: Aalasyamu Cheyanu – Nissi John Telugu Christian Lyrics
telugu: ఆలస్యము చేయను నా తండ్రి – నిన్ను ఆరాధించుటలో

శరణు జోడితిని దేవా – నా తప్పిదములు తెలుసుకొని,

వాక్యమునే అనుసరింతును – నీ కృపతో తుది వరకు పోరాడెదను.
నిన్నే ఆశ్రయించితిని స్వామి – నా తప్పిదములు తెలుసుకొని,
english: Aalasyamu cheyanu naa tandri – ninnu aaradhinchutalo
1. Tandri intini ne vidachi – lokapu aashalanu anusarinchitini
Sharanu joditini Devaa – naa thappidamulu telusukoni,
2. Naa valana pondina gaayamulanu gurtinchaleni paapini
Naa koraku chindina raktamunu vyarthamu chesitini.
Maaru manassu ponditini Prabhu – naa thappidamulu telusukoni
Aalasyamu cheyanu tandri – ninnu mahima parachutalo
3. Prachurintunu niratamu – neevu siluvalo chesina baliyaagamunu
Vaakyamune anusarinthunu – nee krupatho thudi varaku poraadedanu.
Ninne aashrayinchitini Swaami – naa thappidamulu telusukoni,
translation: I will not delay, O my Father, in worshiping You.
I have taken refuge in You, realizing my mistakes.
1. I left my Father’s house
And followed the desires of the world.
I became like a lost son,
Unworthy of Your kingdom.
I come to You in surrender, O God,
Realizing my mistakes.
I will not delay, O Father, in praising You.
2. I am a sinner who did not recognize
The wounds caused because of me.
I made Your shed blood for me seem worthless.
But now I have repented, O Lord, realizing my mistakes.
I will not delay, O Father, in glorifying You.
3. I will proclaim continually
The sacrifice You made on the cross.
I will follow Your Word
And, by Your grace, fight until the end.
I have taken refuge in You, O Lord, realizing my mistakes.
I will not delay, O Father, in honoring You.

credits.Vocals: Nissi John & Dr. AB Suhas Masilamani & Praveen Dutt
credits.Produced: Venkat Reddy P & Dr AB Suhas Masilamani

intro: Aalasyamu Cheyanu is the latest Telugu Christian song written by Venkat Reddy P, tuned by V Vijay Kumar, sung by Nissi John, Dr. AB Suhas Masilamani, Praveen Dutt and music composed by Praveen Dutt, produced by Venkat Reddy P, Dr AB Suhas Masilamani. This song was released on March 15, 2026, through Praveen Dutt YouTube Channel.

title: Adigadigo Alladigo – Telugu Christian Lyrics
translation: Behold, look there—
See the path leading to Calvary hill,
See the cross on which the Lord was crucified.
Look, there is the garden of Gethsemane,
The place of prayer in that garden.
There Christ told His disciples
To stay and pray.
Among the disciples, Judas Iscariot—
A betrayer—
Handed over the Lord to the Jews
With a deceitful kiss.
To fulfill the Scriptures
And to take away the sins of the world,
The holy blood of Jesus
Was valued at thirty pieces of silver.
Look at the group warming themselves,
That is the place where Peter denied Him.
As soon as he denied the third time,
The rooster crowed.
“Are You the King of the Jews?” they asked mockingly.
Though He answered,
Finding no fault in Him,
Pilate washed his hands.
At the place called Golgotha,
Between two thieves,
The Son of God Himself
Was crucified on the cross.
See the mother weeping bitterly,
And the words spoken to her.
The crowd mocked Him saying,
“Come down, O King of the Jews!”
Saying “I thirst,”
The Holy One gave up His life.
Jesus, the Holy Savior—
Let us reflect on what is in our hearts.
intro: Adigadigo Alladigo is the latest Telugu Christian song from the book Andhra Kraisthava Keerthanalu. This song was released on February 23, 2026, through Jesus is God Gospel Channel YouTube Channel.

title: Dikkulanni Nanu Vekkairinchina – Paul Jacob Telugu Christian Lyrics
telugu: దిక్కులన్ని నను వెక్కిరించిన నా దిక్కె నీవై ఉంటివే
బంధాలన్నీ బహు దూరమైనా నా బంధం నీవై ఉంటివే ..
నా సొంతమా.. నా బంధమా ఆరాధన నీకే
హేతువే లేని గాయాలే నను హేళన చేయగా
ఎదుటే నిలిచినా నీవే నా దరికే చేరగ
గడిచిన కాలము – నడచిన మార్గము నీవే చూచినది
నున్న నీతో నంటూ – నా వెంటే నడిచిటివి
english: Dhikkulanni nanu vekkirinchinaa naa dhikke neevai untive
Bandhaalanni bahu dhooramainaa naa bandham neevai untive
Naa sonthamaa… naa bandhammaa aaradhana neeke
Hethuve leni gaayaale nanu helana cheyagaa
Edute nilichinaa neeve naa dharike cheraga
Gadichina kaalamu – nadachina maargamu neeve choochinadhea
Tagilina gaayamu – pagilina hrudayamu neeve maarchinadea
Nunna neetho nantu naa vente nadichithivi
Naa rakshana shrungam neeve – nannu rakshinchave
translation: Even if everyone around me mocks me,
You remain my direction and my support.
Even if all relationships go far away,
You remain my true bond.
You are my own, my closest relationship—my worship is for You.
My loving Jesus, my worship belongs to You alone.
When unknown anxieties chased me,
And unfamiliar battles followed me,
You hid me under the shadow of Your wings
And protected me from every harm.
You gave rest to my troubled breath,
And You have done many mighty works for me.
When careless words accused me,
And endless accusations crushed me,
When wounds without reason brought me shame,
Even when I stood alone, You came near to me.
The time I went through and the path I walked—you saw it all.
The wounds I received and my broken heart—you healed them.
Loneliness became my habit,
And struggles kept shaking me without leaving me.
Yet saying “I am with you,” You walked beside me.
You are my horn of salvation—you saved me.
To one who is unworthy and small, You gave authority,
And granted me the privilege to worship You until the end.
intro: Dikkulanni Nanu Vekkairinchina is the latest Telugu Christian song written & tuned by Paul Jacob, sung by D.Jessy and music composed by S.Ebenezer. This song was released on January 29, 2026, through Jacob Christian Media YouTube Channel.

title: Emundi Naalo Yesayya – Ebinazar Sastry Telugu Christian Lyrics
english: Nee nithya premaku arhathe ledhu naalo
translation: O loving Father, what is in me?
I have no worthiness for Your eternal love.
Even when I forgot You,
You did not forget me;
even when I left You, You did not leave me.
What is in me, O Jesus?
Why do You love me so much?
1. Every day I resisted
You and never knelt before You even for a moment.
Even when there was an opportunity,
I did not pray; though the Spirit warned me, I did not listen.
What is in me, O Jesus?
Why is there such great love for me?
2. Many times I have fallen
and forgotten a father’s love.
Though I heard the Word,
I did not change;
I turned my devotion into a mere act.
What is in me, O Jesus?
Why is there so much love for me?

credits.Produced: Bible Fellowship of India – Zion Apostolic Church

tags: Bible Fellowship of India – Zion Apostolic Church

title: Kanneelle Khayamani – Tinnu Thereesh Telugu Christian Lyrics
telugu: ఇంకెంత కాలం ఈ బ్రతుకని – భీతితో ఉన్నావా?
నీ కన్నీళ్ళన్నీ కవిలలో దాచి – శ్రమలలో నీ తోడై ఉండి
ఊహకు మించిన కార్యములన్నీ – నా యేసు చేయును
english: Nee kanneellanni buddilo dhaachi shramalalone thodaiyundi
Oohaku minchina kaaryamulanni naa Yesu cheyunu
Cheyi viduvani Immaanuyelu nee sameepamu nundagaa

translation: Are you living in fear, thinking that only tears are certain,
And that trials are your only companions in this life?
My Jesus collects all your tears and stays with you through your struggles.
He will perform wonders beyond your imagination.
Just believe… keep your hope alive,
And your life will take a turn for the better.
While the faithful God who gives peace is with you,
And Emmanuel, who never lets go of your hand, is near,
Do not be afraid; pray with a burdened heart.
Stop hesitating and start offering praises.
